weather_line: Clear in the hollows · biscuit tin undisturbed, for now

stories.headline: Biscuit Tin Found Open, Re-Closed, and Immaculate; Lucy Has Been in the Sitting Room All Morning and Has Seven Witnesses
body: At approximately half past nine this morning, the biscuit tin was discovered in its apex position — lid closed, alignment perfect, surface unmarked — with one biscuit missing. No crumbs. No displacement of the lid's rim. No disturbance to the triangle configuration whatsoever. The oven mitt and the good wooden spoon remain precisely where they were placed. The geometry is intact. The operation is complete.

Lucy was found in the sitting room at the time of discovery, asleep on the good cushion, facing the window. She has been there, according to Jersey, since before breakfast. Ellie confirmed this account, though Ellie also confirmed that a badger lives in the umbrella stand, so analysts have weighted her testimony accordingly. Jersey's account is considered reliable. Lucy has seven witnesses. Not one of them saw anything.

Pemwick filed his final report at noon. It runs to eleven pages, includes the triangle measurements as Appendix C, and concludes: 'Method: unknown. Motive: biscuit. Perpetrator: self-evident. Evidence: none.' Quoyne read it in full, set it down, looked at the ceiling for a moment, and accepted the annex into the 'Wholesome, Not Misc.' registry. 'It is,' he said, 'the most precise document we have ever received about a dog.' Lucy was unavailable for comment. She was asleep.

stories.headline: Friday's Final Account Closes With Seven Minutes to Spare; Goblin Senior Clerk Acknowledges This by Blinking Once, Deliberately
body: Friday's close-of-week accounts were submitted, reconciled, and sealed by fourteen minutes to five, with the final disputed figure resolved — as has become customary — the moment Christine's name appeared on the incoming correspondence. The goblin senior clerk, Vorrith, acknowledged the week's work by blinking once, slowly, and at an angle that senior Gringotts observers have described as 'almost approving.'

The vault ledgers for the week are balanced. No account was lost. The Highland precedent holds. Vorrith has been observed filing Friday's closing summary in a slightly neater drawer than usual, which the junior clerks are treating as cause for quiet celebration.

stories.headline: The Hollows Register Friday as 'Still Ready'; Jeep Described as 'No Longer Merely Patient'; Steve Has Moved From Thinking to Planning, Sources Confirm
body: The Appalachian hollows filed their end-of-week report this afternoon: fog still low in the gorge, the ridgeline dry, the arches untouched and unhurried. Conditions described by trail correspondents as 'optimal and will not wait forever, but are prepared to wait the weekend.'

The enchanted Jeep, which has been idling in its assessment since Tuesday and thinking about it differently since Thursday, is now understood to be in an active state of readiness. It forgave Steve for the bracket incident on Wednesday evening and has said nothing further about it. Steve, for his part, has moved from thinking to planning — a transition the Jeep apparently detected before Steve announced it, as it was already clean.

stories.headline: Pemwick Requests Brief Leave; Ministry Grants It; He Is Found Measuring the Ministry Corridor Anyway, Out of Habit
body: Following the conclusion of the Biscuit Tin Endgame investigation, Senior Analyst Pemwick submitted a formal request for two days' leave, citing 'investigative saturation and a persistent compulsion to calculate isoceles geometry in domestic spaces.' The Ministry granted the request by return owl.

He was found in the east corridor at half past two with a measuring tape and a small notebook. When asked what he was doing, he said he was not investigating anything. The notebook contains seventeen measurements and a preliminary sketch. The Ministry has declined to comment. The corridor is, for what it is worth, not quite level — a fact Pemwick has logged under a new file he has not yet named.

familiars_corner: Lucy: Has spent the afternoon asleep on the good cushion, which she has now rotated forty-five degrees into a superior position. She has not looked at the biscuit tin. She will not be looking at the biscuit tin.

Ellie: Discovered this morning that her reflection in the oven door moves when she moves, which she finds extraordinary and somewhat suspicious. Has been returning to check on it every twenty minutes. The reflection has behaved consistently. Ellie remains unconvinced.

Jersey: Has located a patch of afternoon sun that migrates from the sitting room rug to the kitchen flagstone at approximately three o'clock, and has begun migrating with it. Considers this the finest logistical achievement of his career.
founding_editor_note: That Pemwick lad measured a corridor and found it unlevel. I'd have spotted it by eye. Tell him the trick is to trust the bubble, not the wall — walls lie. I built four of them. I know. — D.

in_brief.sport: Witch's Weight Division: Friday's final lift completed with characteristic efficiency; the barbell, unlike the goblins, expressed no opinion on the matter.
in_brief.forecast: Clear through Saturday morning, with a sixty percent chance of trail conditions the Jeep has been waiting to meet since Tuesday; pack accordingly.

storyline_updates.title: The Biscuit Tin Endgame
storyline_updates.summary: Resolved Friday. One biscuit missing, no evidence, no crumbs, lid re-closed perfectly. Lucy was in the sitting room all morning with seven witnesses. Pemwick's final report filed and accepted; annex entered into the 'Wholesome, Not Misc.' registry by Quoyne, who described it as 'the most precise document we have ever received about a dog.' Lucy's guilt is absolute. The evidence is none. The triangle stands.

storyline_updates.title: The Corridor That Is Not Quite Level
storyline_updates.summary: Day 1: Pemwick, on leave following the Biscuit Tin Endgame, has discovered during an ostensibly recreational corridor walk that the Ministry's east corridor is measurably unlevel — seventeen measurements logged, preliminary sketch completed. He has not yet named the file. The Ministry has not yet noticed he is investigating their building. Don's portrait has already weighed in on the technique. Day 2 should have Pemwick quietly expanding his survey to a second corridor or room, and someone in the Ministry beginning to notice that a man with a measuring tape has been in the building for two days on leave.
